item.description: Missing or incomplete implementation of Nextcloud plugin causing test failures related to group expansion and caching. Several tests are failing due to incorrect handling of user/group lookups and caching mechanisms.
item.contract: Implement proper group expansion logic that correctly handles user lookups for groups and all users. The plugin should properly expand #groups, @users, and 'all' targets. Implement caching mechanism that properly stores and retrieves user lists for groups and users to avoid redundant lookups.

item.description: Resend plugin has validation issues preventing instantiation. Tests show TypeError when creating instances with valid parameters, indicating problems with URL parsing or validation logic.
item.contract: Fix Resend plugin instantiation by implementing proper URL validation and parameter checking. Ensure the plugin correctly parses API key and email addresses from URLs and validates them according to expected formats.

item.description: SendGrid plugin has validation issues preventing instantiation. Tests show TypeError when creating instances with valid parameters, particularly around email validation.
item.contract: Fix SendGrid plugin instantiation by implementing proper email validation and URL parsing. Ensure the plugin correctly validates email addresses and handles edge cases like invalid email addresses.

item.description: Apprise class has issues with isinstance checks causing failures in API tests. Tests indicate that isinstance(None, NotifyBase) returns False but should return True for valid objects.
item.contract: Fix isinstance checks in Apprise class to properly validate plugin instances. Ensure that when a plugin is successfully instantiated, it correctly returns an instance of NotifyBase and passes isinstance checks.

item.description: CLI persistent storage functionality fails to create expected storage files. Tests show assertion error where 'ea482db7' is not found in ['apprise.cfg', 'ca496c12'] indicating storage path or file creation issues.
item.contract: Fix CLI persistent storage functionality to properly create and manage storage files. Ensure that when persistent storage is enabled, the correct storage files are created and stored in the specified path.
